youtube_description:
Direct from FreedomFest 2014, Kyle Platt speaks with THE Steve Forbes! They discuss the amazing technological innovations present at FreedomFest, from Bitcoin to 3D printing. It always seems as if libertarians are on the cutting edge of technological innovation, from a development or investment standpoint. 

Forbes also discusses why he attends FreedomFest every year, and how important it is to continue supporting the ideas of individual freedom. He also talks about checking out Liberty.me, so hopefully we can find him there soon!
